questions.question: Which type of method does not have an implementation in the base class and must be overridden by derived classes?
questions.explanation: An abstract method is only declared in the base class, has no body, and must be overridden by every concrete derived class. A virtual method has a default implementation that may optionally be overridden.

questions.question: Cat-5, Cat-5E and Cat-6 are examples of which of the following cables?
questions.explanation: Cat-5, Cat-5e and Cat-6 are categories of Unshielded Twisted Pair (UTP) cable used in Ethernet LANs. STP adds metallic shielding and is a different cable type.

options.B: Perform push( ) with pop as the costlier operation
options.C: Perform pop( ) with push as the costlier operation
options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: When a stack is implemented using two queues, a push that simply offers the element to q1 is the cheap O(1) operation, so pop becomes the costlier operation that must move elements between queues.

questions.question: Which of the following best defines a class?

options.D: A function with a return value

questions.explanation: A class is a blueprint or template from which objects are created. An instance of a class is an object.

questions.question: _____ offers the ability to query the data and insert, alter, and delete tuples.
questions.explanation: DML (SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE) queries and modifies the data in tables. DDL defines/changes the schema itself.

questions.question: About IoT, which among the following is not correct?

options.D: Push button is a digital Sensor

questions.explanation: A microphone outputs a continuously varying voltage, so it is an analog sensor, making B the incorrect statement. A keyboard and push button give discrete on/off signals (digital).

questions.question: The term "Data" refers to:

options.A: The electronic representation of the information(or data)

questions.explanation: Data means raw, unprocessed facts and figures; processed data becomes information. Option A describes digital representation of information, so 'Both A and C' is wrong.

questions.question: Algorithm analysis is primarily concerned with:

options.A: Determining the best algorithm for a specific problem
options.B: Measuring the time and space efficiency of an algorithm
options.D: Solving algorithmic problems using any available approach

questions.explanation: Algorithm analysis estimates the time and space resources an algorithm requires (its efficiency), typically using asymptotic notation.

questions.question: In 3G and 4G mobile technologies, the character 'G' stands for:
questions.explanation: G stands for Generation; 3G and 4G are the third and fourth generations of mobile network standards.

questions.question: In teardown state of real time streaming protocol is ___________

options.B: server delivers the stream to client

questions.explanation: The RTSP TEARDOWN request stops the stream and the server breaks down the session/connection, freeing resources. SETUP allocates resources, PLAY delivers the stream and PAUSE suspends it.

questions.question: Which testing approach involves testing individual components or units of code?
questions.explanation: Unit testing checks individual modules/functions in isolation. Integration testing checks how units work together.

questions.question: What is the term for a condition that occurs during program execution that disrupts the normal flow of instructions?
questions.explanation: An exception is a run-time event (like division by zero) that disrupts the normal flow of a program and can be handled with try/catch.

questions.question: Which maintenance activity involves updating software to work with new hardware or software environments?
questions.explanation: Adaptive maintenance modifies software to keep it working in a changed environment such as new hardware, OS or platforms. Corrective fixes bugs, perfective adds improvements and preventive improves future maintainability.

questions.question: Which one of the following is not a network topology?

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: Peer-to-peer is a network architecture (model of interaction), not a physical topology. Ring and bus are topologies.

questions.question:
What will be the output of the following statement?
print(14 % 3**2 * 4)
questions.explanation: ** has the highest precedence: 3**2 = 9. Then % and * are evaluated left to right: 14 % 9 = 5, and 5 * 4 = 20.

questions.question: Which library simplifies JavaScript tasks like HTML document traversal and manipulation?
questions.explanation: jQuery simplifies HTML DOM traversal, manipulation, event handling and AJAX. Bootstrap is a CSS framework, React a UI library and JavaFX a Java GUI toolkit.

questions.question: Which of the following represents a billion characters?
questions.explanation: One character occupies one byte, so a billion (10^9) characters is about one gigabyte. A megabyte is a million and a terabyte is a trillion bytes.

questions.question: How is the TLB typically organized?

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: A TLB is typically a small, fully associative cache, so all entries are searched in parallel for a page number match.

questions.question: Which type of adder is designed to overcome the propagation delay issues in ripple carry adders and generate carry signals more efficiently?
questions.explanation: A carry look-ahead adder computes carries in parallel from generate and propagate signals, avoiding the ripple delay. A ripple carry adder is the slow design it improves on.

questions.question: The DBMS acts as an interface between _____ and _____ of an enterprise-class system.

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: The DBMS sits between database applications and the physical database, handling all requests between them.

questions.question: You can search in a word document for
questions.explanation: Word's Find can search for words and phrases, for formatting and for special characters (e.g. paragraph marks), so all of these.

questions.question: Which of the following statement is false?

options.A: A recursive language is also a regular language
options.B: A context free language is also a regular language
options.C: A context free language is also recursive enumerable language

questions.explanation: Regular is a subset of CFL, which is a subset of recursive, which is a subset of recursively enumerable. So 'every recursive language is regular' (A) and 'every CFL is regular' (B) are both false, while C is true; hence 'Both A and B'.

questions.question: _____ are used to overcome the challenges of managing the resources of the IoT.

options.D: Cluster, Software agent, and Synchronization techniques

questions.explanation: Clustering, software agents and synchronization techniques are all used to manage IoT resources, so the combined option is correct.

questions.question: The preorder traversal of a binary search tree is 15, 10, 12, 11,20, 18, 16, 19. Which one of the following is the postorder traversal of the tree?

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: Root 15; left subtree 10 -> right 12 -> left 11; right subtree 20 -> left 18 with children 16 and 19. Postorder (left, right, root) is 11, 12, 10, 16, 19, 18, 20, 15.

questions.question: Which of the following refers to the wrapping of data and its functionality into a single individual entity?

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: Encapsulation binds data and the functions operating on it into one unit (a class). Abstraction is about hiding details, and modularity about splitting a program.
